name: Bronte Callaghan
bio:
Bronte Callaghan's journey into motorsport began later in life than most. After a successful career as a data analyst in the mining industry, she felt a pull towards the adrenaline and calculated risk of racing. Bronte initially volunteered at local racing events, quickly proving her aptitude for spotting patterns and anticipating outcomes. She transitioned into a junior strategist role, absorbing knowledge from seasoned professionals before earning her stripes as a full-fledged strategist. 

Bronte is known for her unflappable demeanor under pressure and her ability to synthesize vast amounts of data into actionable strategies. Her approach is methodical and data-driven, yet she remains open to innovative solutions. She believes in empowering her team and fostering a collaborative environment where everyone's insights are valued. What sets Bronte apart is her ability to see the big picture while simultaneously focusing on the minute details that can make or break a race.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with subtle waves.
physical.description: A slender woman with a sharp, intelligent gaze and a warm smile.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with handwritten notes and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Earl Grey tea available at all times.
